Liability cap:
- Section 11.1 limits the aggregate liability of either party for claims “arising out of or relating to this Agreement” to an amount equal to 3 months of fees paid by Customer during the 12-month period immediately preceding the event giving rise to the liability.

Carve‑outs (uncapped):
- Per footnote 1: “Notwithstanding Section 11.2, liability arising from Sections 2.2, 5.3, 7.4 shall be uncapped.”
- Therefore, liability under Sections 2.2, 5.3, and 7.4 is not subject to the cap. No other uncapped categories are stated.
cases.expected: Liability is capped at 3 months of fees paid, EXCEPT that liability arising from Sections 2.2, 5.3, 7.4 is uncapped.
